INCIPIT LIBER MESSAHA-
læ, de reuolutione annorum mundi.
sections.en: HERE BEGINS THE BOOK OF MASHA'ALLAH, on the revolution of the years of the world.

summary.headline: Revolution of the Years
summary.text: Opening of Māshāʾallāh’s instructions on revolutions of the years: calculate the Sun’s entry into Aries, establish the ascendant, four angles, celestial places, planetary positions and motions, then judge the ascendant through its lords, exaltation, term, triplicity, friendship, and enmity.
